verdict.rationale: Community reports say Granola can be started for free with a limited number of notes, and the docs name Business and Enterprise plans, with some features such as workspace API keys gated to them. Only the HIPAA/PHI Enterprise use case points to sales, so there is no evidence of a sales wall for basic use. Missing for 10: published per-tier prices, a first-party plan comparison showing what each paid tier adds, first-party documentation of free-tier limits.
